failure_diagnosis.method: checked heavy-atom completeness of all pocket residues within 8A of the BWY ligand centroid, directly against the ORIGINAL downloaded 6AUD.pdb (not a receptor-prep-pipeline artifact -- same raw file used throughout this project since early sessions)
failure_diagnosis.finding: 15 pocket residues have incomplete heavy-atom counts in the actual deposited 2.015-A crystal structure, including Val882 (the verified hinge H-bond anchor, missing side-chain CG1/CG2) and Trp812 (verified specificity-pocket anchor, missing backbone N/C/O and ring CD1)
failure_diagnosis.interpretation: genuine crystallographic disorder/incompleteness in this specific PDB entry, not a bug in this project own receptor-preparation pipeline -- plausible real cause of the observed self-docking instability (wide seed-to-seed RMSD spread, 1/5 pass) since missing side-chain atoms near the binding site can create artificial extra pocket volume the docking search exploits inconsistently across seeds
failure_diagnosis.recommended_next_step: per Gate 4 (ensemble receptor expansion), gamma is the isoform with the strongest documented case for using a real, more complete alternative structure or a locally-repaired/rotamer-completed model rather than relying on 6AUD alone -- this finding directly motivates that gate rather than being a dead end

gate1_overall: PARTIAL: alpha PASS, delta PASS, gamma FAIL (diagnosed -- genuine crystallographic incompleteness near binding site, not a pipeline bug), beta not applicable (no experimental co-crystal, per mandate section 3.3/4.5)
